ios.desc:
Track anything, uncover actionable insights, and reach any health and fitness goal with Coefficients.

Coefficients unlocks the full potential of your health data to improve any aspect of your health and fitness with extensively customizable dashboards, in-depth charts for monitoring relationships in your data, personalized recurring and long-term goals, intelligent insights, and support for over 200 data types from the Health app as well as your own custom data types. 

Customizable Dashboard:
Build your dashboard with fully customizable widgets that let you easily keep track of all of your health and fitness data, recent workouts and sleep sessions, goal progress, and habits. 

In-Depth Charts:
Visualize your health and fitness data over any time frame with flexible bar, line, and point mark charts. Plot out single metrics for quick reference or up to 5 simultaneously to uncover the relationships in your data that are shaping your health and fitness.

Comprehensive Goals:
Set highly customizable goals for any habit, routine, or recurring, cumulative, or long-term objective. Set goals on any data type for anything from a basic daily objective to in-depth completion criteria including specific times of day, daily, weekly, or monthly completion counts, specific days of the week, cumulative totals, and deadlines. Visualize your goals on your dashboard with calendars, rings, heat maps, charts, and more.

Custom Data Types:
Create your own data types to track your supplements, medications, routines, protocols, symptoms, outcomes, behaviors, and much more, all in one place. Custom data types help you stay on top of your health and fitness by tracking any factor that may be impacting your well-being, from how sleeping with headphones affects your nighttime wake-ups to how a new routine is correlating with your skin health. You can also set up highly specific reminder schedules on custom data types to remember to log your data.

Intelligent Insights:
As your health and fitness change over time, Coefficients will automatically surface significant or notable changes, emerging trends, correlations, goal progress, habit consistency, and more. Leverage your insights to identify patterns, enhance your approach, and hit your goals.

quotes.text:
I recently released my first major iOS app Coefficients. Coefficients is a health data visualization app that allows you to create a dashboard of fully customizable charts and widgets that you can organize however you need to easily monitor any of your health and fitness data types as well as the relationships between them. In addition to the over 200 supported data types from the Health app you can create custom data types to track practically anything. You can also visualize how life circumstances affect your health and fitness by creating a log of chapters, which are customizable date ranges where an event that may affect your health has or will occur. In addition to manual logging and analysis the app will provide automatically generated insights that highlight emerging trends and relationships in your data.

The app provides an immense number of possibilities and it was a goal of mine to make sure it is highly adaptable to the diverse needs of users. It can be used as anything from a basic habit tracker or supplement/medication log to a general purpose health dashboard.

I hope that this is exactly what someone out there was looking for and I would appreciate anyone's thoughts or feedback on the project.
